component.name: NoteyMcNoteface
component.summary: A tabbed text editor that remembers your notes between sessions

description.p: NoteyMcNoteface (Notey) is a native text editor for GNOME and Zorin OS. Tabs, including unsaved and untitled ones, come back exactly as you left them after a restart or a crash.
It highlights source code and markup, finds and replaces with plain text or regular expressions, and detects, shows and converts text encodings and line endings.
Registers many more file types and adds Preferences switches to make Notey the default app for each family of them.
First release: persistent tabs, syntax highlighting, comment toggling, find and replace with regular expressions, encoding and line-ending conversion, and preferences including the indent width.
